1: 1. Both hands of the uncle of the Prophet (peace be upon him): Abū Lahab son of ‘Abdul Muṭṭalib have lost because of the loss of his actions; he used to harm the Prophet (peace be upon him). His efforts are in vain.
2: 2. How much can his wealth and his children benefit him? They cannot defend him against the punishment, nor bring any mercy to him.
3: 3. On the Day of Judgement, he will soon enter the flaring hellfire and suffer its heat.
4: 4. And his wife Umm Jamīl who would also harm the Prophet (peace be upon him) by throwing thorns into his path, will also enter it.
5: 5. Around her neck will be tightly bound a rope with which she will be dragged into the hellfire.
